info.title: AssureX Claim Engine API
info.description:
REST API for the AssureX warranty claim engine. It exposes the same authentication, product, evidence, adjudication, reviewer and administration capabilities as the original server-rendered application, backed by the same SQLAlchemy database and ML models.

Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description: Self-registration. Only customer / service_center roles are accepted.
Exchange credentials for a signed bearer token (and a same-origin session).
Clear the same-origin session. Bearer tokens are stateless: discard them client-side.
Upload a standalone evidence file into the document vault.
Save human-corrected OCR fields for a document.

Create a claim.

``action_type=draft`` stores a draft without running the ML pipeline.
Any other value performs full dual-model adjudication and returns the
resulting claim, including the dossier.
